row: The Kind Farm Inc. Horse Rescue

The Kind Farm Inc. is a horse rescue helping horses who, without us, have no other hope. Saving horses from slaughter, racing and sporting injury and neglect.
Follow their healing journeys and see the beauty and magic of horses and consent, freedom-based handling, connecting and training.
See the horses heal and find loving forever homes.
